Tandem QLED는 복수의 발광 단위를 직렬 적층해 높은 휘도와 효율: A tandem QLED stacks several light-emitting units in series and can in theory reach higher luminance and efficiency, but the first tandem QLEDs I fabricated actually had lower luminance and current efficiency than a single QLED. If the interconnecting layer (ICL) between the upper and lower units can't generate and inject charge properly, the tandem structure loses its advantage. I needed to check from several angles whether uneven charge injection inside the ICL was the main cause, and improve it by optimizing process conditions.
본 연구는 단계적인 소자 제작과 특성 분석을 통해 Tandem QLED의: This research found and fixed the cause of tandem QLED performance loss through step-by-step device fabrication and characterization. With a single QLED as the reference device, I quantified the performance gap and narrowed down the cause by combining J-V-L measurement, EL spectra, AFM surface analysis, J-V analysis of ICL-only devices, and emission analysis of mixed Green/Red QD devices. In the end, I showed that changing only the spin-coating RPM of ZnMgO and PEDOT:PSS can improve performance.

The initial tandem QLED had lower luminance and current efficiency than the single QLED, so I evaluated the surface morphology of the ICL interfaces, charge generation and injection, and the emission spectra of mixed Green/Red QD devices. Uneven charge generation and injection in the ZnMgO/PEDOT:PSS ICL was judged to be the main cause, and adjusting the spin-coating RPM to optimize ICL thickness and charge injection raised luminance and current efficiency substantially.
생활 소음에 민감한 사용자는 어떤 가전이 언제, 어느 정도 소음을 내는지: People sensitive to household noise can't easily tell which appliance makes how much noise, and when. A plain dB reading can't tell sources apart, and sending raw audio to a server is a heavy privacy cost. Mobile, sensor, server, and desktop all ran on different runtimes, so labels, IDs, and event contracts had to stay consistent across them, and Serial, Wi-Fi, and external AI services could fail at any moment and break the user flow.

Noise and environment data measured by ESP32 sensors flow into a Spring Boot backend and feed sensitive-appliance alerts, low-noise responses, routine suggestions, AI reports, and a Tauri 3D home scene. Raw audio never leaves the device (privacy by design), and failures at each layer are absorbed by local queues, reconnection, and multi-stage fallbacks.
